svg.title: Power of the paired test against the number of tasks
svg.desc: Power of the two-sided exact McNemar test at 0.05, counting rejections in the team's favour, for true gains of 5, 10 and 15 points, against the number of tasks on a log scale from 20 to 1,000. Lines: rollout noise 2 of 39. Shaded bands: between no noise and noise 16.9%. Each gain has its own colour and marker shape (5 points a circle, 10 points a square, 15 points a diamond). Marked: the pilot's 48 tasks, 80% power, the 231-task pool and its expected 158 valid tasks.
svg.text: Dashed: 80% power and the pilot's 48 tasks. Numbers on the 0.8 line: smallest n with power of at least 0.80 at noise 2 of 39.
